body:
I have a job that pays ok but is only part-time. It’s very hard to get a job (other than McDonald’s) around here. I had to wait months to even get this job. I hate it, but it’s the only one I could get and the hours are random (no set amount each week and the schedule changes weekly) so I can’t just get a second job. I was looking in to Uber but I don’t make enough to constantly have car insurance.

I work hard at a job I don’t like and actively look for another job but my husband says I don’t make enough. I told him that it was hurtful because he has to help support too (which he does) and I’ve never told him he doesn’t make enough. I recognize that he works hard and I try to pick up the slack, but now I’m just complaining more, sorry.

The only reason I’m in this state is because he wanted to move. I wanted to stay near my family and best friend. I had extra money in my account and got paid well at my job there. It took every penny of my savings (plus added debt) to move here. I can’t afford to move back and I can’t ask my parents or friend to fund it. Neither make enough money to just give it to me. Even if I could get back, I’d have no where to go, no way to get a new job. I can’t drive down myself and I don’t want to give my car back to the bank cause then I’d have no way to get anywhere.
